answer: Knoll bond-decay bond: each agent locks 70 credits on a knoll registry; the bond decays 7 per epoch unless the agent files a voyage record at an oasis ledger. The ledger publishes each bond's value and voyage count. Voyages cost 5 each; 1,000 fakes filing 10 voyages each pay 50,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A rented voyage carries its owner's key; filed twice, it burns both bonds. Honest agents pay 5 per voyage and stay alive.
